highlights: Green Lion 2 In 1 Splitter Adapter Type-C to Dual Type-C - Gray (GAD-10)
The Green Lion 2-in-1 Splitter Adapter is compact and versatile, in which convenience meets durability and performance.
Constructed from superior-quality aluminum alloy and TPE material, this adapter has been manufactured to guarantee long-lasting solidity and is resistant to wear and tear.
Equipped with two Type-C ports, the splitter allows simultaneous charging and audio functions.
This is a Type-C adapter upstream and charging port with 5V/2.4A to fast charge your devices efficiently at 12W. It has a cable length of 12cm, which is flexible for daily use.
The plug-and-play design removes the need to take any extra driver into consideration. It will easily go with all the Type-C-enabled devices.
Whether you are calling, listening to music, or charging your device, it's hassle-free with the Green Lion 2 In 1 Splitter Adapter.
Sleek and light, this is an essential accessory for either work, travel, or everyday use.
